title: Among KAM-segment customers who made transactions at gas stations in the Cz
question: Among KAM-segment customers who made transactions at gas stations in the Czech Republic (Country = 'CZE'), how many had total gas consumption below 25,000 in 2012?

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT c.XCL_001
  FROM customers AS c
  INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
  INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
  WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'KAM'
    AND g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
    AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2012'
  GROUP BY c.XCL_001
  HAVING SUM(t.XCL_018) < 25000
) AS qualifying_customers

  FROM customers AS c
  INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013

  GROUP BY c.XCL_001
  HAVING SUM(t.XCL_018) < 25000
) AS qualifying_customers
